text.formatted: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned for 24 hours. The poisoned creature is Unconscious. The creature wakes up if it takes damage.
text.plain: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned for 24 hours. The poisoned creature is Unconscious. The creature wakes up if it takes damage.
